title: ELARA's First Recruitment Table Starts New Conversations
summary: An early lab milestone brought students and professionals together around research on technology and aging.

sources.label: Read Chorong Park's original LinkedIn post

paragraphs.text: ELARA Lab hosted its first research study recruitment table, opening a new way for students and professionals to get to know its work. Chorong Park shared the milestone on April 14, 2026, and thanked the team who made it happen.

Park described the activity as a chance to build relationships around technology and aging. The emphasis was on meeting people and growing a research community, with companion robots and study materials helping introduce the work.

For a growing lab, a recruitment table is also a point of contact: an opportunity to start a conversation, not just distribute information. That relationship-building was the part Park highlighted most in her update.
